CHAP. XXV.
6. ro the children of his concubines †S Auguſtin ( li 16. c. 34. de ciurt)
ſheweth that both Agar and Cetura, being Abrahams lawful wiues (for ſo
they are called in holie Scripture ) are alſo called concubines, becauſe they had
not like priuileges to Sara, whoſe ſonne was ſole heyre to his father, and the
children of the others had only giftes (or mouable goods) not attayning to
the promiſed kingdom. And al this formyſterie ſake. For Iſmael ſignified the
carnal people before Chriſt, the children of Cetura prefigured Heretikes,
who ſuppoſe themſelues to pertaine to the new Teſtament, but are ſeparared
no leſſe then the Iewes from Chriſts Ringdom. And albeit there was alſo an
other particular reaſon, why Agar was called concubine, becauſe ſhe was a
ſecond wife, the firſt then liuing, yet this Ierned father ſaith, he did not ſee,
why Cetura being maried after the death of Sara, ſhould be called concubine,
but only for this Myſterie.
